chunks: God, your Lord, and the Lord of your fathers?
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is the Lord of our fathers?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah As-Saff, this verse serves as a rhetorical challenge to the Israelites, reminding them that the God they worship is the same Lord of their forefathers, thereby validating the continuity of prophetic tradition. Shia scholarship often highlights this as a basis for the unbroken chain of divine guidance (Tawatur) and the legitimacy of the Imams as inheritors of this ancestral lordship. It underscores that true monotheism requires acknowledging God's sovereignty over both past and present communities.
